summary: createLocalSessionStore now keeps each chat's unsent composer text in the same browser storage and key prefix as the chat, so it survives a reload; drafts: false turns it off. Own SessionConfig stores can add draft.
howTo: Nothing to do with createLocalSessionStore: drafts are stored as `${storageKey}:draft:<chatId>` and removed when sent, when the chat is removed, cleared or evicted, and by clearLocalSessionStore on sign-out. Pass drafts: false to keep them in memory only. An own SessionConfig can add draft: { load(id), save(id, draft | null) } (ComposerDraftStorage); writes are debounced 300 ms and flushed on chat switch and pagehide, drafts over 20,000 characters are not written, errors are ignored. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#drafts-across-reloads.
